metaDescription: Meet NMESIS Motion Lab, the studio behind automotive digital twins, cinematic CGI, configurators and interactive brochures that change how people experience cars online.

hero.title: We bring cars to life. Online.
hero.description: An automotive studio bringing together visual craft, engineering and a curiosity for what comes next.

origin.title:
CGI artists at heart.
Automotive technologists by evolution.
paragraphs: NMESIS brings CG artists and software engineers together around a shared fascination with cars. We care about the things that give each vehicle its character: a surface, a reflection, the feel of a cabin.
Based in Egypt and the UAE, we work with automotive teams to translate that character into a digital experience. Our founders stay close to the work, from the first conversation to the final detail.
origin.alt: GAC interior CGI showing the leather, carbon fibre and metal finishes of the centre console
origin.caption: GAC · A study in materials, light and detail.

evolution.title:
From the vehicle
to the experience.
evolution.description: Four ways our work brings people closer to a car. Each example comes from our studio.

stages.title: Digital twins
stages.description: It begins with the vehicle itself. Geometry, materials and individual components come together in a detailed digital model.
stages.caption: Watch the digital vehicle come together.

stages.title: Automotive CGI
stages.description: Light, camera and movement give that model a presence. Our GAC Empow launch film shows the finished craft in motion.
stages.caption: GAC Empow · Cinematic launch film.

stages.title: Configurators
stages.description: The viewer takes control. This AVATR 12 interface brings together colours, environments, cabin views and vehicle details.
stages.alt: AVATR 12 configurator with interior, exterior, environment and feature controls
stages.caption: AVATR 12 · Pixel-streaming configurator.

stages.title: Interactive brochures
stages.description: A car’s story, ready to explore. The IM6 brochure connects an immersive cabin with feature explanations in one online experience.
stages.detailAlt: IM6 brochure feature cards for air suspension, cruise control, thermal management and parking
stages.caption: IM6 · Cabin exploration and feature stories.

principles.title:
Care in the details.
Clarity in the experience.

items.title: Know the vehicle
items.description: We study the references, specifications and local trims before making creative decisions.

items.title: Stay close to the team
items.description: Artists, engineers and clients share feedback throughout the work, so decisions stay connected.

items.title: Keep exploring
items.description: Our lab gives us room to test new lighting, movement and ways to interact.

clients.title: Trusted across the automotive industry.
clients.description: Working with the teams and authorized distributors representing leading automotive brands.

working.title:
From the first scene
to the final frame.
working.description: Our artists develop the scene, refine the surfaces and build the lighting together. This IM Motors breakdown opens up that process, showing how an unfinished scene becomes the launch film.
working.closing: A look inside the work, layer by layer.

cta.title:
Bring your vehicle
to life online.
cta.description: Tell us what you have in mind. We’ll work out the next step together.

mission.title:
Change how people
experience cars online.
paragraphs: We want discovering a car online to feel like getting to know it. To step inside, look closely, try a different finish and understand what a feature does, wherever you are.
Our mission is to make that experience more intuitive, more informative and closer to the real vehicle.

mission.caption: Cadillac VISTIQ · See online exploration in action.
